basic_profile.bio: I'm a 29-year-old software developer who recently moved from Sacramento to France. I love exploring new cultures and have a particular interest in cryptocurrencies and blockchain technology. I enjoy reading sci-fi novels and spend a lot of my free time playing video games. I work remotely for a tech company based in California, so I'm often online during the late evening hours in France. I'm currently in a long-distance relationship with my partner who lives in the US.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Computer Science and have spent the last five years working in software development, focusing on blockchain technologies. I'm also self-taught in financial markets and enjoy investing in cryptocurrencies. My knowledge is a mix of formal education and self-driven learning through online courses and forums.
